overview_description.description:
Incorta is a data analytics company on a mission to help data-driven enterprises be more agile and competitive by resolving their most complex data analytics challenges. Its Direct Data Platform gives enterprises the means to acquire, enrich, analyze and act on their business data with speed, simplicity, and insight. 

Backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Kleiner Perkins, M12 (formerly Microsoft Ventures), Telstra Ventures, and Sorenson Capital, Incorta powers analytics for some of valuable brands and organizations in the world. For today’s complex data and analytics challenges, Incorta partners with Fortune 5 to Global 2000 customers such as Broadcom, Vitamix, Equinix, and Credit Suisse.

about_short_description.short_description: Incorta is a unified data and analytics platform.

product.name: Incorta Platform
product.description: A unified data and analytics platform that connects complex enterprise systems, delivers live analytical data, and supports governed reporting, applications, and AI-driven workflows.

product.name: Incorta Intelligence
product.description: An operational AI layer that combines live structured and unstructured enterprise data with semantic context, retrieval, reasoning, and governed agent orchestration.

product.name: Incorta Connect
product.description: A data connectivity and harmonization capability that links enterprise systems and combines data from multiple sources for analysis and AI applications.

product.name: Incorta Data Applications
product.description: A governed application capability for creating and deploying business applications on live Incorta data, enabling users to move from analysis to operational action.

product.name: Incorta Governance
product.description: Built-in controls for managing enterprise data access, security, compliance, lineage, and auditing across analytics, applications, and AI workloads.
